chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The divorce of the slave man to the free woman is three divorces, and the divorce of the free man to the slave woman is two divorces.
ai.seo_question: How many divorces are required for a slave man to finally divorce a free woman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the jurisprudential distinction in talaq counts for mixed-status marriages, reflecting the principle that the status of the wife often dictates the severity of the divorce procedure. It highlights the scholarly consensus that a slave man divorcing a free woman requires three talaqs for finality, whereas a free man divorcing a slave woman requires only two, underscoring the nuanced application of marital laws based on social hierarchy in early Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A divorce of the owned slave to the free woman are three divorces, and a divorce of the free man to the slave woman are two divorces’.
